_comment: M-DEPTH DP4: the second new market stall's mini-buy surface. Rides krshia_crate.json's EXACT shop-option contract (requires:{gold:price} paired with effects:[{gold:-price},{item:id}], price named in the option's own text -- WIDialogue strips the generated 'Worth N gold' effect_line from a shop option by matching that literal prefix, so the price only ever appears once, authored here). Sells exactly ONE item (watch_issue_gambeson, now priced at 20g -- previously fixture/harness-only, no live acquisition path) -- deliberately smaller than Krshia's multi-option shop, per the task's 'one mini-buy' scope. The Peddler is a title, not a proper name (matches the existing gate_guard/watch_guard precedent for unnamed Watch-adjacent flavor NPCs) -- profile in docs/design/character-profiles-staging.md.

hub.speaker: Peddler
hub.text: Watch gear, mostly honest. Some of it's even been laundered.

bought.speaker: Peddler
bought.text: Deposit's already paid, so don't ask where it came from. Wear it in good health.
